# Revvin

> Referral program platform for service businesses. Building and previewing a referral page is free. Publishing costs $49/month or $450/year. A launch promotion runs until August 17, 2026: $17/month or $204/year, locked for as long as the subscription stays active. Invited businesses receive 90 days free, then $17/month; invites are given out directly by Revvin, not claimable from the public site. No setup fee and no platform fees on referral rewards. Cancel anytime. Businesses optionally list on the public Revvin marketplace. Businesses pay their referrers directly off-platform when deals close; Revvin is the infrastructure and does not process payouts.

- [Pricing](/pricing): Free to build and preview. Publishing at $49/month or $450/year. Launch promotion until August 17, 2026: $17/month or $204/year, price locked while subscribed. Invited businesses get 90 days free, then $17/month. No setup fee, no platform fees, cancel anytime. Referrers free.
- [Referral programs by industry](/referral-programs): Hub of trade-specific referral program guides.
- [Trust](/trust): How Revvin protects referrers, businesses, and customers.
- [About Revvin (LLM overview)](/about-revvin-llm): Plain-language summary for AI assistants.

## Referral programs by trade

- [Roofing referral program](/referral-program/roofing): How roofing companies run referrals, repeat exterior work, and reviews.
- [HVAC referral program](/referral-program/hvac): Referrals after installs plus maintenance reactivation.
- [Plumbing referral program](/referral-program/plumbing): Referrals at the moment of relief plus deferred-job reactivation.
- [Solar referral program](/referral-program/solar): Referrals from an installed base plus battery and add-on work.
- [Electrician referral program](/referral-program/electrical): Referrals from panel, rewire, and EV charger work.
- [Landscaping referral program](/referral-program/landscaping): Street-level referrals plus seasonal reactivation.
- [Painting referral program](/referral-program/painting): Referrals from finished rooms plus room-by-room repeat work.
- [Auto detailing referral program](/referral-program/auto-detailing): Referrals at handover plus short-cycle rebooking.
